newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Everbright firms down after unit suspends HK trade. [CORRECTED 8:44 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Everbright firms down after unit suspends HK trade. [CORRECTED 8:44 GMT]

text.p: Shares of China Everbright International Ltd and China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd fell on Tuesday following a trading suspension of China Everbright Technology Ltd, brokers said.
"A trading suspension of China Everbright Technology fuelled hope of a possible injection of the HK Telecom stake by the parent into the unit," a sales manager at a local brokerage said.
"Investors took profit on the other two when they were seen to be unlikely to receive the injection," he said. (Corrects to show other units unlikely to receive injection of stake)
Shares of China Everbright International edged down HK$0.07 to HK$1.93 in mid-morning, while China Everbright-IHD fell HK$0.25 to HK$9.05.
Trading in China Everbright Technology shares was suspended on Tuesday morning at the company's request pending an announcement.

On Friday, CITIC Pacific Ltd said it would sell its 7.74 percent stake in Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd to China Everbright Holdings, the parent of the China Everbright group of companies listed in Hong Kong.
